final_decision.verdict_rule: exp37 per-step rule: deterministic steps, PSNR 30-40 dB → UNCERTAIN (severity ±1 band); >40 dB would be LIKELY
final_decision.rationale: Final candidate reproduces every content-independent signal of the target near-exactly: block_boundary 0.9949/0.9932 (−0.0017), unique_G 183/187, dct_zero 0.506/0.510, sigma 1.48/1.48, gm_ratio 0.2728/0.2902, spectral_slope_ratio 1.0673/1.0653, mean_shift −82.5/−81.4, clipped_fraction 0.0637/0.0634, variance_ratio 0.287/0.330, chroma_ratio 0.320/0.341, spread_ratio 0.584/0.618. Component evidence: (a) darkening is multiplicative, not additive — any additive shift ≥81 clips >12% of pair0's pixels while target clips only 6.3% (R6 vs R14); gamma_RGB sev5 best (RGB 3.2 per-channel > V-gamma 3.5: PSNR 35.86 vs 34.24); (b) saturation weaken confirmed by Cr/Cb std ratio 0.34 and best matched by YCrCb sev2 (chroma 0.320; HSV2→0.445, HSV3→0.326 but brightens mean and drops PSNR to 31.19); (c) mild gaussian blur sev1 required — without blur gm_ratio stays 0.775 vs target 0.290 (R7), blur sev2 oversmooths (gm 0.169, dct 0.72; R9); lens variant slightly worse (35.23); (d) no JPEG — block_boundary stays ~1.00 in all 5 support pairs and JPEG candidates over-block (bb 1.72 with sev2-sev3) and over-quantize (dct 0.75-0.81 vs target 0.51); dct elevation is explained by darkening+clipping alone; (e) no noise — sigma 1.48<2, peeled residual fully structured; (f) legal pipeline: blur×1, brightness(global)×1, saturation(global)×1, no compression step, 3 steps total. Order blur(priority1)→brightness/saturation(priority2) is generator-legal when brightness draws priority2; alternative orders scored lower (brightness first: 32.50; sat before bright: 34.82).
